messages:
Anya: Quick share — finished an initial bring-up for 'horizon-lite-9b' quantized to int6. Put a short cost-vs-quality summary below; ran three slices (longform summarization, search-recall, short-chat).

Sam: Awesome, which benchmark harness did you use?

Anya: Used the standard onboard harness (200 samples per slice, mixed real-prod prompts + synthetic edge prompts). Key numbers:
- Latency p95: int8=120ms, int6=210ms (measured on gtx-like instance with our runtime layering)
- Throughput: tokens/sec down ~18% on int6 vs int8
- Unit cost (raw infra) per 1k tokens: int8 ~$0.012, int6 ~$0.007 => ~1.7x cost savings.

Lee: If latency p95 almost doubles for some routes, product impact may be visible. Quality deltas?

Anya: Quality summary:
- Longform (ROUGE-L relative): -0.7 points avg on int6 vs int8
- Search/recall (MRR): -0.9% absolute on top-k retrieval relevance (failure modes are mostly numeric grounding)
- Chat (human QA score, 5pt scale): -0.05 pts mean, more variance on multi-turn slot-population prompts
- Hallucination proxy (entity halluc rate): +0.5% concentrated on numeric/date extraction slice

Marta: So per-1k token cost drops ~40%, quality hits small but concentrated. Any per-route unit econ breakdown?

Anya: Yes, rough blended unit-econ for our sample traffic mix (70% chat, 20% search, 10% longform):
- int8 blended infra cost per 1k tokens: ~$0.0102
- int6 blended infra cost per 1k tokens: ~$0.0061
- blended quality score (weighted): int8=0.964, int6=0.955 (on our score metric normalized to 1.0 baseline)

Sam: How noisy are these numbers? 200 samples per slice sounds small.

Anya: Fair — CI is non-trivial. Bootstrap suggests ROUGE CI ±0.3, MRR ±0.6%. Recommend a larger 1k-sample canary for search if we want production confidence.

Lee: Prescriptive ask from product/GTN: what would you recommend for rollout and routing flags?

Anya: Proposed operational plan:
1) Hybrid routing: route sensitive slices (search, numeric-extraction, billing prompts) to int8; cheaper, less-sensitive chat variants -> int6.
2) Canary plan: 1k-sample shadow test + 5% live traffic on chat route, 20% on search route for 48h with automatic rollback if MRR drops >0.5% or halluc proxy increases >1.0%.
3) Prompt-level mitigations: strengthen retrieval prompts and add numeric-checking post-filter for longform summaries for int6.
4) Caching & prefix reuse: increase prefix cache TTL for longform to reduce token spend in majority of cases.

Sam: Can you paste the routing rule prototype?

Anya: Sure — quick example (pseudo):
```
route_rule {
  match: request.metadata.slice in ["search","billing"]
  model: "horizon-lite-9b-int8"
  fallback: "horizon-lite-9b-int6"
}
route_rule {
  match: request.metadata.slice == "chat" && request.estimated_tokens < 1024
  model: "horizon-lite-9b-int6"
}
canary {
  route: "search"
  traffic_pct: 20
  guard: { metric: "MRR", threshold: -0.5 }
}
```

Marta: That looks reasonable. For GTN messaging we need an expected savings range and a note on customer impact. Could you provide a concise blurb?

Anya: Blurb suggestion: "Int6 provides ~35–45% infra savings with small average quality regressions; recommend hybrid routing: keep int8 for high-precision retrieval and numeric-sensitive features, use int6 for bulk chat traffic. Start with a 48h canary on key routes and require MRR/hallucination gates before full rollout."

Lee: OK — follow-ups: generate 1k-sample extended report and a short product-facing one-pager for GTN. Also include a list of prompt patterns to avoid canonical failure modes.

Anya: Will do. Quick note: we found two small prompt patterns that spike hallucinations on int6 — prompts that ask for multi-step numeric reasoning and very long context with many dates. We'll add guardrails to detection heuristics.

Sam: DeployBot — can you kick off the 5% canary for chat when the 1k-sample job finishes?

DeployBot: Canary scheduled: horizon-lite-9b-int6 chat route, 5% traffic, start=2026-03-23T15:12Z. Monitoring hooks: MRR, latency_p95, hallucination_proxy.

Marta: Thanks everyone — this is exactly the kind of actionable unit-econ + product guidance we can send to GTN. Please drop the 1k results link here when ready. :thumbsup:

Anya: Will upload the extended scorecard + sample failures in ~6h and ping PMs. :eyes:
